correctness.rationale: The 2026 Arapura--Greer--Zhang paper proves the four singular-fiber types, Picard rank 20, determinant 48 and the isometric index-four specialization into A2. Kodaira vanishing orders sum to nine for a degree-eight Weierstrass coefficient, yielding f=0 and a primitive cubic automorphism. A rank-two Eisenstein module with determinant 48 has Gram 4A2. Its norms are multiples of eight, so the image in A2 lies in 2A2 by a mod-two norm argument; identical index four forces equality and cokernel (Z/2)^2. Standalone exact checks passed, finite calculations not substituted for proof.
